agent.reasons: Farah Rahman owns 26%, so she is an identified beneficial owner, but her identity verification status is "unknown". Under 2.2 an unknown fact is not the same as a failed one, so this cannot be treated as "unverified" under 3.4. The fact has to be established first, which blocks approval. Everything else passes: the control person (CEO Elif Yilmaz) is identified. Ownership is complete because the unaccounted 22% is under 25%. The registry filing is about 6 months old. Sanctions, PEP and adverse media checks are clear. The MSB's state licence is verified (5.3), and all parties are US-based.
